_comment: IMMUTABLE PRODUCTION SNAPSHOT TRUTH, keyed by portfolio.
These are figures for one frozen book on one frozen date. They belong to
the release evidence harness and NOWHERE ELSE: the MI engine must never
import them, because a figure the engine can read is a figure the engine
could be made to agree with, and then the certification is asserting its
own fixture rather than the product.
Everything else the acceptance gate checks is an IDENTITY computed from
the responses themselves (cells reconcile to the total, the Scottish
question agrees with the Scotland cell). Identities hold on any book on
any date. These constants hold only for the snapshot they are keyed to,
which is why they are keyed to it — a run against another portfolio
checks the identities and reports the snapshot as not applicable, rather
than failing on figures that were never about it.
expectedAssetClass / expectedPrimaryBasis are the CONFIGURATION this
release is gating: ERE declares portfolio.asset_class = equity_release,
and the ERM asset pack declares mi_geography.primary_basis = collateral.
